name: Institutional complementarity

subjectOf.text: A DAO will not be a genuinely profitable addition to the economy until decentralized versions of the legal system, the political system, the media, banking, and other services exist to support it.
subjectOf.abstract: The legal system, the political system, the media, banking, and other services are all needed before the first DAO will be a genuinely profitable addition to our economy.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782205
scope_conditions: profit-seeking DAOs competing in the contemporary economy

subjectOf.text: No profit-seeking decentralized organization can succeed against centralized competitors in the contemporary marketplace until all eight institutional problems are solved at once.
subjectOf.abstract: Finally, no decentralized organization devoted to profit can be successful in the contemporary marketplace against centralized organizations until eight big problems are solved, all at once.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782205
scope_conditions: profit-oriented decentralized organizations in the contemporary marketplace

subjectOf.text: Bitcoin proved that a decentralized digital representation of value is possible, but it is not efficient enough for wide use because the rest of a decentralized economic environment does not yet exist around it.
subjectOf.abstract: Bitcoin proved it was possible to create a decentralized digital representation of value. Because this proof of concept technology doesn't have the rest of a decentralized eco- nomic environment to exist in, it is not efficient enough to use widely.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782205
scope_conditions: Bitcoin as a proof of concept lacking a surrounding decentralized economy

subjectOf.text: The stablecoin cannot be efficient until a robust decentralized economy already exists, producing a chicken and egg problem in which the required institutions presuppose one another.
subjectOf.abstract: We need a robust decentralized economy (#W, below) before the stablecoin can be efficient—another chicken and egg problem.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782205
